**** **** **Fairfax, VA – September 10, 2026 –**[WidePoint Corporation](https://www.widepoint.com/)


**(NYSE American:**[WYY](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/WYY?p=WYY) **)** , a leading provider of Secure Mobility Management solutions, today announced it will be featured as a presenting company at the H.C.


Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference. The conference is being held on September 14-16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel, New York City.


WidePoint management will present an overview of the Company’s business on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. Eastern time. WidePoint management will also be available for one-on-one meetings during the conference.


The presentation will be available for viewing online via webcast


[here](https://journey.ct.events/view/43c3f9cc-e09b-428d-aef2-12bc4a7ca2ed) .


##### **About WidePoint** **** WidePoint Corporation (NYSE American: WYY) is a leading technology Managed Solution Provider (MSP) dedicated to securing and protecting the mobile workforce and enterprise landscape. WidePoint is recognized for pioneering technology solutions that include Identity & Access Management (IAM), Mobility Managed Services (MMS), Telecom Management, Information Technology as a Service, Cloud Security, and Analytics & Billing as a Service (ABaaS).


To learn more, visit


[https://www.widepoint.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-benG2EayMI_6PDJpln_gdENvd0OZeNXHsr_Q9rJ4UEJ5-aliecCf-JGdUZqgwyH7hhORQtiQuPLhXZRvDxPpwj9E5Ro0cpmZ_8hxZjMTMA=) .
